functions.name: create-article

FunctionOutput_gainsight_cc_restorequest.description: Acknowledgment that the existing question was restored from trash, without asserting public visibility.

tags.instructions: Use the original private question ID and an authorized moderator ID. Read trash using `get-question` with moderator context if needed. This reverses `delete-question`; it does not bypass other approval or category restrictions.

functions.name: search-topics
functions.description: Search topic titles and content across the community, optionally restricting to trashed topics, categories, content types or tags.

tags.description: Public tag names for provider matching.

limit.description: Maximum matches in this page; defaults to 25.

query.description: Full-text term matched against topic title and content; omit for filter-only discovery.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation scoped to the connection, complete search criteria and limit.

trashed.description: Filter by trash state; omission returns only visible topics, true requests trashed topics.

categoryIds.description: Category IDs restricting search; omission includes all categories.

contentTypes.description: Provider content type values restricting search.

moderatorTags.description: Nonpublic moderator tag names for provider matching.

FunctionInput_gainsight_cc_searchtopics.description: Full-text topic search criteria and page continuation.

id.description: Original private content ID scoped by contentType.

sticky.description: Whether pinned.

content.description: Topic content retaining Unicode and provider markup.

trashed.description: Whether original content is trashed.

createdAt.description: Creation instant in UTC with original precision.

replyCount.description: Visible reply count.

contentType.description: Original content type, including future provider values.

publicLabel.description: Article public label, preserving empty values for other types.

voteUserIds.description: IDs of users in the provider vote set.

items.description: User ID from the provider vote set.

productAreas.description: Provider product area labels or opaque values, not assumed IDs.

items.description: Product area label or opaque value.

featuredImage.description: Article featured image URL or empty string, preserving nonarticle empty values.

lastContributorId.description: Most recent reply author's user ID.

items.description: One page of matching topic projections in provider search order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation token; omitted when exhaustion is established.

FunctionOutput_gainsight_cc_searchtopics.description: One ordered page of matching topics and optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use this for full-text discovery or finding trashed content; use `list-topics` for product-area, date-range and ordering filters. Results identify original content by id and contentType. Omit query for filter-only discovery. Continue with nextCursor as cursor and unchanged filters and limit.

functions.name: update-article-content
functions.description: Replace an article's opening post content without changing its title or other fields. Requires moderator authority.

content.description: Complete replacement opening content, preserving Unicode and provider markup; cannot be empty or null.

authorId.description: User ID of the moderator making the edit, supplied upstream as authorId.

FunctionInput_gainsight_cc_updatearticle.description: Article identity, moderator identity, and complete replacement opening content.

id.description: Private article ID whose content update the provider acknowledged.

FunctionOutput_gainsight_cc_updatearticl.description: Acknowledgment of the article content replacement.

tags.instructions: Use the private ID from `get-article`, `list-articles`, or `create-article`, and a moderator user ID as authorId. This overwrites the entire opening content, not a patch within the text. For the title use `update-article-title`.

functions.name: update-article-publication
functions.description: Publish a draft article using a moderator identity.

articleId.description: Private ID of the article to publish.

moderatorId.description: Community user ID of the moderator publishing the article.

FunctionInput_gainsight_cc_updatearticle.description: Article identity and moderator authority for publication.

id.description: Private article ID for which publication was acknowledged; does not prove notification delivery.

tags.instructions: Use the private ID from `create-article` or `get-article` and a valid moderator ID. Publishing changes article visibility; it is not the same as creating a draft. No unpublish tool is available here. Check `get-article` after an ambiguous outcome before retrying.

functions.name: update-article-title
functions.description: Replace an article title as a moderator without replacing its opening content.

articleId.description: Private article ID whose title is replaced.

moderatorId.description: Community user ID of the moderator editing the title.

title.description: Complete replacement title as ordinary text; no null or empty clearing.

id.description: Private article ID whose title change was acknowledged.

FunctionOutput_gainsight_cc_updatearticl.description: Acknowledgment of the title edit, not a fetched article.

tags.instructions: Obtain a private ID from `list-articles` or `get-article` and a valid moderator ID. This replaces the complete title; use `update-article-content` for opening content.

functions.name: update-conversation-content
functions.description: Replace a conversation's opening content as its author within the edit window, or as a moderator.

content.description: Complete replacement opening content; preserve provider markup and Unicode, with no null or empty clearing.

authorId.description: User ID of the original author or moderator making the edit.

conversationId.description: Private conversation ID whose opening post is edited.

functions.name: update-conversation-title
functions.description: Replace a conversation title using a moderator identity.

title.description: Complete replacement title; no null or empty clearing.

moderatorId.description: User ID of the moderator editing the title.

FunctionInput_gainsight_cc_updateconvers.description: The private conversation, editing moderator, and complete replacement title.

id.description: Private conversation ID whose title change was acknowledged.

tags.instructions: Use a private conversation ID from `list-conversations` or `get-conversation` and a moderator ID. This overwrites only the title. Use `update-conversation-content` to replace the opening post.

functions.name: update-idea-status
functions.description: Replace an idea's assigned status as a moderator.
